title: fix(plugin-chatbot): a plan that overlaps an existing app asks whether to extend it or build a new one, instead of offering Build it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_

Fixes #27480
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:AI 搭建方案若与用户已有的应用重叠(结果带 `decision: 'iterate_or_new'`),方案卡不再显示「开始搭建」,改为提问「在「X」上继续完善,还是另建一个独立应用」,两个选项各自发出对应回复;普通方案不变。
- 为什么改:之前这类结果被画成普通方案卡,一键「开始搭建」就会造出一个和已有应用重复的新应用。
- 风险与回滚:只在识别到 `iterate_or_new` 时换掉按钮行,其余方案走原路径;回复文字按会话语言发出,且不会被确认门当作同意;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 的 `IterateOrNewQuestion` 与按钮行三分支;其次 `mapMessages.ts` 的 `liftIterateOrNew`;再看 `useChatConversation.ts` 缓存回写。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.iterateOrNew-27480.test.tsx`,预期 10 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Detection (`mapMessages.ts`).** `detectProposedPlan` lifts `decision: 'iterate_or_new'` into a new optional `ProposedPlan.iterateOrNew`, with the overlapping app's `name` and optional `label` read from `existingAppOverlap`. A result with the decision but no objects still yields a plan, so the card asks the question instead of falling back to the generic "Build it" card. An overlap that names no app yields `iterateOrNew: {}`.
- **The question (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`).** For such a plan the card keeps its rows and replaces "Build it" / "Adjust" with `IterateOrNewQuestion`. The question names the app (`label`, else the host's `resolveAppLabel(name)`, else `name`). Its two choices are "Keep improving X" and "Build a separate, new app", and each sends its answer through `onSendMessage`. Without a send channel, or without an app name, the card shows the question and a reply hint and offers no one-click choice. Once a build has run after the plan, the question stays and the choices go, as the plan's own buttons already do.
- **Outbound answers.** Two new optional props, `planExtendExistingMessage(app)` and `planBuildNewAppMessage`, with English defaults. The console wires both through `resolveOutboundAgentText`, so they follow the conversation's language like the plan card's other outbound messages. The new keys `console.ai.planExtendExistingMessage` and `console.ai.planBuildNewAppMessage` are in the `en` and `zh` packs only, as the other outbound keys are.
- **Reload.** Server history re-parses the stored result with the same detector. The message cache's compact plan envelope (`proposedPlanToCachedResult`) now writes back `decision` and `existingAppOverlap`, so a cache-fallback reload asks the question too.
- **Labels.** `chatbot.plan.iterateOrNew.{question, questionUnnamed, extend, buildNew, replyHint}` in all ten packs.
- **Docs.** One paragraph in `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` after the plan-card description.
- One patch changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Tests

- `mapMessages.iterateOrNew-27480.test.ts` (7): the lift from the bare result and from the `{type, value}` wrapper; a plain result has no `iterateOrNew`; another `decision` value is ignored; a result with no objects still yields a plan; `label` is optional and an overlap with no app gives `{}`; the live mapper carries the field.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.iterateOrNew-27480.test.tsx` (10): no approve, adjust or fallback button and the question names the app (asserted first); the plain proposal keeps "Build it" and "Adjust" (control); each choice sends its answer; the host's outbound text is sent when supplied; zh labels; no objects still asks; `resolveAppLabel`; the unnamed overlap; no `onSendMessage`; the settled state after a build.
- `AiChatPage.iterateOrNewReload-27480.test.tsx` (3): server history re-parses to the question; the cache fallback keeps both keys and both re-maps render the question; a plain proposal is cached without the keys (control).
- `AiChatPage.planCardLocale.test.tsx`: the two answers follow the conversation, not the UI locale (zh thread under en/zh/de UI, en thread under zh/en/de UI).
- `outboundAgentText.test.ts`, `outbound-agent-messages.test.ts`, `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts`, `console-namespace-3546.test.tsx`: the two outbound keys are registered. `i18n.test.ts`: neither answer, in zh or en, matches the confirm gate's approval pattern.

## Acceptance notes

- **The result shape is read flat and unverified against the producer.** The cloud half (cloud#3369) was not readable from this container, so the reader takes `existingAppOverlap.name` / `.label` as the card quotes them and tolerates their absence: a missing or differently nested app gives the unnamed question with a reply hint, never the "Build it" card. The cloud#3369 owner should confirm the nesting.
- **Ablation** through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each anchor x1 to x0 with the blob changed, and each file restored to equal HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - A1, the lift always returns nothing (`mapMessages.ts`): 16 red, 4 green (the plain controls) over the three new files.
  - A2, the question face off (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`): 11 red, 9 green, with the mapper tests green. A2b, run alone on the first test, fails on the missing-approve assertion.
  - A3, the cache write-back off (`useChatConversation.ts`): only the cache-fallback test red.
  - A4, the console's outbound wiring bypassed (`AiChatPage.tsx`): the six conversation-language tests red.
- Three i18n test files outside the named surface (`all-locales-key-parity`, `console-namespace-3546`, `i18n.test.ts`) gained the two keys. They are the same key ledgers the named `outbound-agent-messages.test.ts` reads.
- The plugin README lists no plan-card props, so it is unchanged. The docs paragraph is the documented surface.

## Verification

See the PR's check-runs for every family CI runs. Local readings (targeted vitest, type-check of the three packages, the derived gate list) are in the os-dev report on #27480.
